# Test files

`version.rar` and `crypted.rar` (password `unrar`) are from the test data of the
[unrar](https://github.com/muja/unrar.rs) crate (MIT licence). The app can't make
RAR files, so its tests read these.

`parts.7z` (a block STL and a note) and `locked.7z` (password `model`) were made
with the `sevenz-rust2` crate for the page checks.
